svg.title: Two deliberately unsupported transfers
svg.desc: Left: the fitted fixed-kappa map is compared with a target at diffusivity0.02. Right: the input contains a fourth cosine mode absent from the three-mode representation. Both failures occur despite successful same-family grid reuse. All quantities are nondimensional.
